title: Layering in one module: ixdar-app stays one module; an ArchUnit test enforces the package layers, the web build excludes desktop packages, and the platform/registry leaks are fixed
description:
User ruling 2026-10-22, after reviewing the four-module split: separate Maven modules are not wanted (too many modules, scenes scattered across modules, an unreviewable diff). Everything stays in ixdar-app, scenes all in ixdar.scenes. The four-module version is kept as checkpoint commit c37b502f on branch eng-30 (also in the reflog) as the source for the leak fixes.

What ENG-30 was for, achieved in one module:
1. Layering enforced by a test: one ArchUnit test (test scope, in ixdar-app) states the package layers in readable rules, e.g. ixdar.numeric / ixdar.geometry / ixdar.nodegraph (pure) import no LWJGL, Assimp, Gson, OpenAL, MKL/javacpp, Manifold or TeaVM and nothing from scenes/graphics/gui/tools/automation; the engine packages (graphics, gui, tools, input, models, scenes, game, procgen) import no LWJGL backend, OpenAL, native solver or automation; only ixdar.automation uses Gson/HTTP; desktop-only packages (LWJGL/headless backends, IxdarWindow, native solvers, Manifold, Assimp, desktop-only nodes, devtools) are named explicitly. Scenes may use desktop-only nodes (the quad and boolean scenes stay in ixdar.scenes). `mvn test` fails naming the class and the forbidden import.
2. The web-teavm profile compiles with explicit source excludes for the desktop-only packages, so TeaVM cannot reach them because they are not compiled; WebPlatform's null automation()/audio() and 'TeaVM must not reach X' care go.
3. The leak fixes from the checkpoint, kept: the desktopOnly registry twin and its Class.forName replaced by the registry-suffix generation (desktop-only nodes and scenes in their own generated registry, registered at startup); Platform's desktop-only methods removed (font atlas via the shared JSON reader, loadImage returning DecodedImage, no newModelRuntime, no automation(), requestClose()); GL's shader list owned by ShaderProgram; automation's reach-ins removed (FileManagement.checkoutRoot, MeshExport formats, NetworkTracer.UNCONSTRAINED, CollectionManifest, Scene.dataset(LAYOUT)); annotations module free of app base types and Gson; the fertility_quad_layout.dsl stale path fix.
No package moves between modules, no new modules, no class renames; tooling (ixdar-cli, launch.json, ixd) stays on the ixdar-app layout.
definition-of-done:
1. The reactor is annotations + ixdar-app as on master; no new modules; every scene stays in ixdar.scenes.
2. An ArchUnit test enforces the package layers above and fails on a violation (shown by a deliberately broken import during development).
3. The web-teavm profile excludes the desktop-only packages from compilation and `ixdar-cli teavm-build` passes; the desktopOnly twin and Class.forName are gone.
4. The leak fixes listed are in; generated route and node catalogs unchanged apart from intended entries.
5. Against the ENG-30 baselines in tmp/eng30-baseline: unit tests, every scene's ui-state and screenshots, the DSL sweep and the quad suite match.
6. The diff against master contains no package moves; ixdar-cli, launch.json and ixd work unchanged.
testing-plan:
1. mvn -q compile and mvn -q test from the root (never install or -pl), including the ArchUnit test.
2. The pid-safe sweep (tmp/eng30-tools/sweep.py) against tmp/eng30-baseline; run_suite.py.
3. ixdar-cli teavm-build.
changes-made:
ENG-30 split (agent, worktree eng-30 off master 7bc04bad, uncommitted).

MODULES. Root reactor: annotations, ixdar-core, ixdar-engine, ixdar-automation, ixdar-desktop, ixdar-web; ixdar-app is gone (files moved with mv, packages and class names unchanged). core = platform interfaces (Platform, Platforms, GL, IxBuffer, input, json, file, concurrent, Clock, Compat), numeric, geometry (mesh, csg interfaces), nodegraph and its node packs, procgen.dungeon.algo/values (the dungeon nodes need them), Color/Palette(s)/LineSet/VertexLayout (pure data the mesh code uses), AudioBackend, the DSL resources and the test meshes. engine = graphics, gui, tools, input, models, scenes, game, procgen, geometry.tsp and geometry.grid2d (they draw: HyperString, Drawing, Camera2D), AutomationBackend, CanvasSceneMap, shaders/textures/terminal/cities/solutions. automation = ixdar.automation, nodegraph.catalog (Gson JSON), devtools ValidateDsl/PatchDecomposerCLI (used by routes), AutomationRoute/RouteDoc*/RouteParam*. desktop = LWJGL/headless platforms, IxdarWindow, AudioSystem, PARDISO/Accelerate, Manifold, Assimp importer and runtime, GsonJsonTree, the 20 desktop-only nodes, the scenes built on them (quad-layout, cross-field-exam, embedded-tmesh, mcg-exam, param-exam, mesh-boolean) and model-load-canvas (Assimp), devtools, BatchDslEvaluator. web = TeaVM backend, WebLauncher, transformers. Dependency tree: core/engine have no LWJGL, Assimp, Gson, OpenAL, MKL/javacpp, Manifold or TeaVM; web has none of the desktop jars.

LEAKS FIXED AT THE ROOT. Platform loses parseFontAtlas (FontAtlasDTO.parse reads Platform.parseJson's JsonValue on every backend; the Gson annotation and WebPlatform's JSO twin are gone), loadTexture becomes loadImage (DecodedImage; callers build the Texture), newModelRuntime (ModelLoadScene, now desktop, builds AssimpModelRuntime) and automation() (Scene.automation, installed by IxdarWindow with the launch scene id and headless flag; AutomationRuntime no longer names IxdarWindow or HeadlessPlatform); Platform gains requestClose (Shutdown route). GL loses getShaders/addShader (ShaderProgram.programs(), per platform id, creation order). AudioBackend carries the read-only state ui-state reports. FileManagement.checkoutRoot/moduleDirectory replace AutomationPortFile.checkoutRoot (RingRegionTool no longer reaches automation). MeshExport owns FORMAT_GLB/PLY and formatOf (Export route no longer reaches ExportMeshNode); NetworkTracer owns UNCONSTRAINED; CollectionManifest names load_mesh's path argument itself; SeamlessDiagnosis reads the layout through Scene.dataset(Subsystem.LAYOUT) (new constant) and the overlay through ModelScene.runtime.

REGISTRATION. The desktopOnly partition, DESKTOP_ONLY_IDS and NodeGraphRuntime's Class.forName are gone. RegistryProcessor takes -Aixdar.registry.suffix: ixdar-desktop generates MeshNodeRegistry_MeshNodesDesktop and SceneRegistry_ScenesDesktop, and IxdarWindow.registerDesktopContent (called by IxdarWindow.main, ExportAutomationRoutes, BatchDslEvaluator and the test suite's SuitePlatform) adds them through NodeGraphRuntime.register and CanvasSceneMap. desktopOnly stays on the annotation as the catalog flag. All processors name their supertype by simple name, so the base types left the annotations module (APIMethod, Subsystem and NodeCategory stay: annotation element types); annotations no longer depends on Gson.

PATHS. Scenes launch on ixdar-desktop's classpath (target/CP written there) with ixdar-engine as the working directory, the module whose files scenes read/write by relative path (shader hot reload, the game's solutions and cache); mesh and DSL paths resolve through MeshLoader.resolve (working dir, checkout root, ixdar-core). Tests live in the lowest module where they compile and run: core 221, engine 74, desktop 308 (every test needing the suite platform or a desktop node); engine reuses core test helpers through ixdar-core's test-jar.

TOOLING. ixdar-cli build_state/run_scene/launch/mesh_viewer/dsl_optimizer/teavm_build/coverage/duplication/new_scene/mesh_catalog follow the modules; .vscode launch entries get projectName ixdar-desktop and cwd ixdar-engine; ai-workspace ixd launch-add detects the IxdarWindow and shader modules so it works on both layouts.

Verification: baselines from an untouched snapshot of master 7bc04bad (tmp/base). mvn test 603/603 before (ixdar-app) and after (core 221, engine 74, desktop 308), per-class counts identical. All 21 CanvasSceneMap scenes launch from ixdar-desktop: ui-state identical (FPS text aside); 3D/mesh scene screenshots byte-identical, 2D canvases differ only at the level two baseline runs differ from each other (animated colours/FPS). DSL sweep over 50 DSLs (mesh fingerprint, ui-state, screenshot): 49 identical incl. dungeon_2d/3d and all ring/quad fixtures; fertility_quad_layout.dsl now loads because its stale ixdar-app/ path was updated to ixdar-core/ (it failed to load before). Quad suite 14/14 MATCH (signature and screenshot). ixdar-cli teavm-build OK, 0 [ERROR], classes.js 7276860 -> 6628916 bytes. Generated outputs: automation_routes.json differs only in source paths and two example paths, mesh-node-catalog.json only in load_mesh's description (which names the module directory), ARCHITECTURE.md package map only in the three package-info texts that described the removed twin. CLI unit tests 104/104. Data in tmp/eng-30-measurements.json, scripts in tmp/eng30-tools/.

ENG-30 layering in one module (agent, worktree eng-30 off master 7bc04bad, uncommitted; redesign of 2026-10-22 replaces the earlier six-module split, every file moved back with mv).

LAYOUT. Reactor stays annotations + ixdar-app; no new modules; scenes stay in ixdar.scenes; no package moves or class renames. The only moved files are the annotation base types (SceneDrawable, Geometry, TerminalOption, OptionList, AutomationRoute, RouteDoc, RouteDocBuilder, RouteParamType, RouteParameterDoc), which go from annotations into ixdar-app under the same packages so annotations no longer depends on app types or Gson.

LAYERS. ixdar-app/test/unit/LayeringTest.java (ArchUnit 1.4.1, test scope) has 4 rules: the pure layer (geometry, numeric, nodegraph, platform interfaces) uses no platform library and no drawing code; the engine uses no desktop backend, native solver, OpenAL or automation; only automation speaks Gson and HTTP; nothing outside the desktop-only files uses them. Failure proof: a temporary org.lwjgl field in MeshExport made the pure-layer rule fail, naming the field (tmp/eng30-layering-violation-proof.log). The field was removed.

DESKTOP-ONLY BUILD. ixdar-app/pom.xml compiles twice: default-compile excludes the desktop-only files (LWJGL/headless platforms, IxdarWindow, AudioSystem, PARDISO/Accelerate, Manifold, Assimp, GsonJsonTree, the quad-layout/network/mesh-IO nodes and the scenes built on them, devtools exporters, BatchDslEvaluator); compile-desktop compiles just those with -Aixdar.registry.suffix=Desktop into MeshNodeRegistry_MeshNodesDesktop and SceneRegistry_ScenesDesktop. A clean-plugin execution forgets compile-desktop's incremental state so it recompiles when default-compile does. IxdarWindow.registerDesktopContent (main, ExportAutomationRoutes, BatchDslEvaluator, test SuitePlatform) registers both. The desktopOnly partition, DESKTOP_ONLY_IDS and NodeGraphRuntime's Class.forName are gone. The web-teavm profile excludes automation, nodegraph.catalog, devtools and AutomationRoute, skips compile-desktop, the exec steps and tests, and builds in target/web so it never overwrites target/classes.

LEAKS FIXED. Platform loses parseFontAtlas (FontAtlasDTO.parse on JsonValue; WebPlatform's JSO twin deleted), loadTexture (now loadImage returning DecodedImage), newModelRuntime, automation() and audio() (Scene.automation and Scene.audio, installed by IxdarWindow; AutomationRuntime gets sceneId and headless and no longer names IxdarWindow or HeadlessPlatform); it gains requestClose. GL loses getShaders/addShader (ShaderProgram.programs()). FileManagement.checkoutRoot replaces AutomationPortFile.checkoutRoot; MeshExport owns the export formats; NetworkTracer owns UNCONSTRAINED; CollectionManifest names load_mesh's path; SeamlessDiagnosis reads the layout through Scene.dataset(Subsystem.LAYOUT). fertility_quad_layout.dsl's mesh path is now module-relative and the mesh loads (it never loaded on master).

VERIFICATION. mvn -q clean compile: route and node catalogs byte-identical to master. mvn test: 607 tests, 0 failures (baseline 603 + LayeringTest 4, per-class counts equal). ixdar-cli unittest 104 OK. teavm-build: 0 errors, classes.js 6,629,596 bytes (baseline 7,276,860). Pid-safe sweep of 21 scenes and 51 DSLs against tmp/eng30-baseline: ui-state and fingerprints equal everywhere except fertility_quad_layout.dsl (now loads, intended); scene screenshot pixel differences are 0.00-0.10%, within the baseline's own rerun noise (ixdar-canvas 4.02% vs 4.00% noise, animated colours). Quad suite: 14/14 MATCH. ixdar-cli, launch.json (plus one ENG-30: quad-layout entry) and tasks.json are identical to master.

TOOLING. Unchanged in Ixdar. ai-workspace keeps ixd/worktree.py module_holding() so launch-add finds the IxdarWindow module on either layout.
Archived 2026-10-24 without landing, as tag archive/eng-30 at 20c7c158: One-module ArchUnit and four-module versions both rejected; redo as one code tree with module poms that compile parts of it
review-summary: ixdar-app's package layers are enforced in one module: LayeringTest states them as ArchUnit rules, a second compile builds the desktop-only files into IxdarWindow's startup registries, and the web profile leaves them out. Platform and registries lose their reachability tricks, so the compiler and a test guard the layering.
